title: Exploring teapot consumer dynamics: the impact of satisfaction, affective reactions, and brand credibility
core_idea: Investigate how teapot/product design (design novelty, pattern aesthetics) together with consumer satisfaction, affective reactions, price perception, service quality, and physical display influence consumers' willingness to repurchase tea sets in the China/Asia–Pacific market, emphasizing economic benefits from innovative design rather than functional improvements and addressing a gap in tea-market research.
tldr: Examines how teapot design and related consumer perceptions affect repurchase intention for tea sets, focusing on design novelty, aesthetics, price perception, service quality, and display in the China/Asia–Pacific consumption context.
